title: 第0097章 腐骨蚀心白鲜皮显威第0096章 前厅立威药气惊四座

第0097章腐骨蚀心，白鲜皮显威！
夜色如墨，青石小径两侧的幽冥鬼火虫散发着惨绿色的微光，将林药尘的影子拉得忽长忽短。
距离家族大比还有三日。空气中弥漫着一种山雨欲来的压抑。林家内部看似平静，实则暗流汹涌。林药尘能感觉到，几道若有若无的神识如同毒蛇般在暗处窥探着他，那是林啸天安插的眼线。
自从他在演武场上以摧枯拉朽之势横扫林莽，甚至隐隐压过了林啸天一头后，整个外门乃至部分内门的目光都聚焦在了这个曾经的“废柴”身上。有惊疑，有不屑，但更多的是贪婪——针对他那神秘莫测的药力。
“这林药尘，难道真的脱胎换骨了？”
“哼，我看是回光返照。少主说了，三日之内，必让他再次沦为死狗。”
“那‘腐骨散’可是少主花大代价从黑市求来的奇毒，发作之时，神仙难救……”
窃窃私语顺着晚风飘来，林药尘面色却古井无波。他早已不是当初那个任人欺凌的废物。体内，“万古药尊系统”正散发着温润而磅礴的力量，丹田内那枚淡金色的药丹缓缓旋转，每一次律动，都带动着四肢百骸的气血奔腾。
他现在缺的不是战力，而是时间。他需要更多的时间来消化仙鹤草的药力，将“药徒三重”的境界彻底夯实，最好能在家族大比前冲击四重。至于林啸天的那些小动作，在他眼中不过是跳梁小丑最后的挣扎。
回到破败的小院，林药尘反手合上门闩。他盘膝坐在那张吱呀作响的木床上，心神沉入体内。
“仙鹤草固元之效仍在持续，受损的经脉已愈合大半，气血充盈。但‘腐骨散’的毒性……”林药尘眉头微蹙。那股阴寒歹毒的劲气并未随着修为提升而消散，反而如同跗骨之蛆，潜伏在骨髓深处，一旦松懈，便会蠢蠢欲动。若非有系统压制，恐怕早已毒发。
“看来，得尽快将白鲜皮的药力彻底激发出来。”林药尘心中暗道。白鲜皮，清热燥湿，祛风解毒，正是克制此类阴湿毒气的克星。只是这株灵药尚在初步融合阶段，药效未显。
就在这时——
“噗！”
毫无征兆，林药尘猛地喷出一口漆黑如墨的淤血！淤血落地，竟将地面腐蚀出嗤嗤白烟，散发出一股腥臭之气。
“不好！”林药尘脸色骤然一白，额头瞬间布满冷汗。那潜伏已久的“腐骨散”毒性，竟在此刻提前爆发了！而且比以往任何一次都要猛烈、都要诡异！
剧痛从四肢百骸传来，仿佛有无数根烧红的钢针，正沿着骨骼缝隙疯狂钻凿。紧接着，一股阴寒彻骨的寒气从丹田升起，迅速蔓延至全身，血液似乎都要被冻结。两种极端的痛苦交织在一起，让林药尘浑身痉挛，几乎咬碎了牙关。
“林啸天……你好狠！”林药尘心中怒吼。对方竟然在他体内下了双重毒素！之前显露的只是表象，这才是真正的杀招——“腐骨蚀心散”！此毒无色无味，发作于无形，专克低阶修士的护体罡气，一旦发作，先是蚀骨，继而腐心，三个时辰内必死无疑！
“警告！宿主遭受高强度毒素侵蚀，‘腐骨蚀心散’发作！”
“生命体征急速下降，经脉冻结风险：90%！”

“建议立即启动‘白鲜皮’本源净化程序！”
系统的提示音急促响起。
林药尘知道，生死存亡，在此一举！他强忍剧痛，全力催动系统，将心神全部集中在那株扎根于丹田药田之中的“白鲜皮”虚影上。
“给我——醒！”
轰！
丹田内的药田仿佛被投入了一颗石子，泛起层层涟漪。那株原本静静悬浮的白鲜皮虚影猛地一颤，翠绿中带着银纹的叶片瞬间舒展开来，一股清新凛冽、带着淡淡药香的白色气流，如同拥有灵智的游龙，自药田中奔腾而出，瞬间涌入林药尘的奇经八脉！
这股白色气流所过之处，那蚀骨的剧痛和阴寒的冻气竟如冰雪遇骄阳，迅速消融瓦解！
“滋滋滋……”
林药尘能清晰地听到体内传来的细微声响，那是白鲜皮药力与“腐骨蚀心散”剧烈对抗、净化的声音。黑色的毒血不断从毛孔中被逼出，在他周身凝结成一层腥臭的黑痂。
过程痛苦无比，如同蜕皮重生。但林药尘死死咬住牙关，眼神锐利如鹰。他能感觉到，随着毒素被不断清除，自身的药力非但没有损耗，反而在这种极致的压迫下，变得更加精纯、凝练！
一个时辰……两个时辰……三个时辰……
当东方天际泛起鱼肚白时，林药尘周身那层黑痂“咔嚓”一声碎裂开来，露出其下新生的、泛着淡金色莹光的肌肤。他长长吐出一口浊气，那气息竟也是白色的，带着一丝若有若无的腥甜味。
“呼……”林药尘睁开眼，眸中精光爆闪，随即恢复深邃。“腐骨蚀心散，终于清除了。”
他内视己身，发现不仅毒素全无，连带着之前受损的根基也在白鲜皮强大的解毒生机之力下得到了进一步巩固。丹田内的药丹，体积似乎膨胀了一圈，色泽更加金黄，表面那层代表“白鲜皮”的银色纹路，也明亮了许多。
“药徒三重……巅峰！”林药尘握了握拳，感受着体内澎湃的力量，嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度。“林啸天，这一笔账，我们该好好算算了。”
他站起身，推开房门。晨曦微露，照亮了他棱角分明的侧脸。一夜恶斗，非但未损他分毫，反而让他身上那种内敛的锋芒更加慑人。
然而，他刚走出几步，眉头却又是一皱。
并非身体不适，而是感知到了一股截然不同的、充满敌意的气息，正如同潮水般从院外涌来。
“林药尘！滚出来受死！”
content_en:
Chapter 0097 Corrodes the bones and corrodes the heart, and the fresh skin shows its power!
The night was as dark as ink, and the ghost fireflies on both sides of the bluestone path emitted a miserable green light, making Lin Yaochen's shadow grow longer and shorter.
There are still three days until the family competition. There is a sense of depression in the air that is about to come. The Lin family seems to be peaceful, but in fact there are turbulent undercurrents. Lin Yaochen could feel that a few vague consciousnesses were spying on him in the dark like poisonous snakes. They were the spies planted by Lin Xiaotian.
Ever since he swept through Lin Mang with a devastating force on the martial arts field, and even faintly overpowered Lin Xiaotian, the eyes of the entire outer sect and even part of the inner sect were focused on this former "waste". There was surprise and disdain, but mostly greed - for his mysterious medicinal power.
"Is this Lin Yaochen really reborn?"
"Hmph, I think he has returned to his former glory. The young master said that within three days, he will be reduced to a dead dog again."
"That 'Rotten Bone Powder' is a strange poison that the young master bought from the black market at a huge price. When it attacks, it's hard for gods to save it..."
Whispers floated in the evening breeze, but Lin Yaochen's expression remained calm. He is no longer the good-for-nothing he used to be. Within the body, the "Eternal Medicine Lord System" is exuding warm and majestic power. The pale golden medicine pill in the dantian rotates slowly, and every rhythm drives the energy and blood of the limbs to surge.
What he lacks now is not combat power, but time. He needs more time to digest the medicinal power of agrimony and thoroughly consolidate the realm of the "Third Level Medicine Apprentice". It is best to reach the fourth level before the family competition. As for Lin Xiaotian's little moves, in his eyes they were just the clown's last struggle.
Returning to the dilapidated courtyard, Lin Yaochen closed the door latch with his backhand. He sat cross-legged on the creaking wooden bed, his mind sinking into his body.
"The effect of agrimony on strengthening the vitality is still continuing. Most of the damaged meridians have healed, and the qi and blood are full. But the toxicity of 'Rotten Bone Powder'..." Lin Yaochen frowned slightly. The cold and vicious energy did not dissipate with the improvement of cultivation. Instead, it was like maggots in the tarsal bones, lurking deep in the bone marrow. Once relaxed, it would be ready to move. If it weren't for systematic suppression, I'm afraid the poison would have spread long ago.
"It seems that we need to fully activate the medicinal power of Bai Xianpi as soon as possible." Lin Yaochen thought to himself. White fresh skin can clear away heat and dampness, dispel wind and detoxify. It is the nemesis of restraining such damp and poisonous gases. It's just that this elixir is still in the initial fusion stage, and its efficacy has not yet shown.
Just then——
"Poof!"
Without any warning, Lin Yaochen suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood as black as ink! The bruises fell to the ground, corroding the ground into white smoke and emitting a fishy smell.
"Not good!" Lin Yaochen's face suddenly turned pale, and his forehead was instantly covered with cold sweat. The toxicity of "Rotten Bone Powder" that had been dormant for a long time actually broke out in advance at this moment! And it was more violent and weird than ever before!
Severe pain came from the limbs and bones, as if countless red-hot steel needles were drilling crazily along the gaps in the bones. Immediately afterwards, a bone-chilling chill rose from his Dantian and quickly spread throughout his body, making his blood seem to be frozen. The two extreme pains intertwined, causing Lin Yaochen to convulse all over and almost break his teeth.
"Lin Xiaotian...you are so cruel!" Lin Yaochen roared in his heart. The other party actually put double poison in his body! What was revealed before was just the appearance, this is the real killer move - "Corroding Bone Corroding Heart Powder"! This poison is colorless and odorless, it acts invisible, and is designed to overcome the body-protecting Qi of low-level monks. Once it acts, it will first corrode the bones, and then the heart, and you will definitely die within three hours!
"Warning! The host is eroded by high-intensity toxins and the 'Corroding Bone Corroding Heart Powder' attacks!"
"Vital signs drop rapidly, risk of meridians freezing: 90%!"
"It is recommended to start the 'White Fresh Skin' source purification program immediately!"
The system's beep sounded quickly.
Lin Yaochen knew that life and death depended on this one move!He endured the severe pain, activated the system with all his strength, and focused all his attention on the "white fresh skin" phantom rooted in the Dantian medicinal field.
"Give me—wake up!"
Boom!
The medicinal field in the dantian seemed to have been thrown into a stone, causing ripples. The white fresh-skinned shadow that was originally suspended quietly trembled suddenly, and the emerald green leaves with silver streaks instantly unfolded. A fresh and white air flow with a faint medicinal fragrance, like a wise dragon, rushed out of the medicinal field and instantly poured into Lin Yaochen's eight extraordinary meridians!
Wherever this white air flow passes, the bone-eroding pain and the cold air melt and disintegrate quickly like ice and snow meeting the scorching sun!
"Zizzizi..."
Lin Yaochen could clearly hear the subtle sounds coming from his body, which were the sounds of fierce confrontation and purification between the medicinal power of Bai Xianpi and the "Rotten Bone Corroded Heart Powder". Black poisonous blood was continuously forced out of his pores, condensing into a layer of smelly black scab all over his body.
The process is extremely painful, like shedding one's skin and being reborn. But Lin Yaochen gritted his teeth and his eyes were as sharp as an eagle. He could feel that as the toxins were continuously removed, not only was his medicinal power not depleted, but it became more pure and condensed under this extreme oppression!
One hour...two hours...three hours...
When the sky in the east turned white, the black scab all over Lin Yaochen's body shattered with a "click", revealing the new skin beneath it, glowing with light golden light. He exhaled a long breath of turbid breath. The breath was also white, with a hint of fishy sweetness.
"Huh..." Lin Yaochen opened his eyes, his eyes flashed with light, and then returned to depth. "Corroding Bone Corroding Heart Powder, finally cleared."
He looked inside his body and found that not only were there no toxins, but the previously damaged foundation had been further consolidated by the powerful detoxifying vitality of Bai Xianpi. The medicinal elixir in the Dantian seemed to have expanded in size, becoming more golden in color, and the silvery lines on the surface representing "white fresh skin" were also much brighter.
"Third level medicine disciple...peak!" Lin Yaochen clenched his fists, feeling the surging power in his body, and raised a cold arc at the corner of his mouth. "Lin Xiaotian, we should settle this account carefully."
He stood up and opened the door. The morning sun shone slightly, illuminating his angular profile. A night of fierce fighting not only did not damage him at all, but made his restrained edge even more intimidating.
However, as soon as he took a few steps, he frowned again.
It wasn't that he felt physically unwell, but that he felt a completely different and hostile atmosphere, coming from outside the hospital like a tide.
"Lin Yaochen! Get out and die!"
